applications.statement: Each actual normalizer-related fiber admits a B-linear geometric isogeny to A, respecting the labeled O-actions on every component.
These actual B-linear maps can be chosen over the same L with degree prime to11, including identity at the identity element.
exclusions: No bound on all other degree primes
